name: user-journeys
description: Service-agnostic user-journey lifecycle: author end-to-end journeys as living documents (current-truth body plus a windowed delta log), validate them against the running product through whatever interface it exposes (web, desktop via MCP, CLI, TUI, API), triage mismatches with intent-gated amendment authority, report findings through a pluggable reporter (GitHub issues or a local tracker), and run multi-journey campaigns with a bounded dispatch-coder fix loop. Ships six skills (init, write, verify, verify-changed, consolidate, campaign), two agents (journey-scribe, journey-validator), the journey format spec and templates, and a deterministic index/lint script.
